metrics.native_launch_to_ready_ms: Process spawn to attached terminal viewport plus one native headless draw. Filesystem caches are warm.
metrics.native_initial_draw_ms: Native view cache/display duration after the viewport is available.
metrics.idle_api_to_capture_ms: Unix API send to shell output observed through capture; excludes physical keyboard and display presentation.
metrics.load_api_to_scrollback_ms: API send to owned tmux capture of 10000 scrollback lines during sustained colored Unicode output; includes capture process spawn.
metrics.resident_process_cpu_core_percent: Cumulative CPU delta of owned resident app, helper, tmux and collector processes. Short-lived helpers can be missed.
metrics.rss_mib: Sum of product resident process RSS. User shells and generated workload processes are excluded.

not_equivalent: Headless native readiness does not establish an OS-presented frame or a cold filesystem launch.
API roundtrip does not establish physical-keyboard-to-render latency.
A short smoke run does not qualify the 60-second idle or 600-second load gates.
